title: The evaluation mate of normalized pullback and internal-Hom adjunctions
statement: For schemes T,S [def-pc-scheme] and g:T→S, fix a: Lg* ⊣ Rg* [def-pc-derived-pullback] [def-pc-derived-direct-image] and tensor-right/internal-Hom adjunctions bS,bT whose inverse Hom equivalences satisfy IsCanonicalDerivedTensorHom [def-pc-canonical-derived-tensor-hom-bijection]. There exist a natural isomorphism t: Lg*(E⊗K) ≅ Lg*E⊗Lg*K satisfying IsCanonicalPullbackTensorComparison [def-pc-derived-pullback-tensor-comparison] and a natural transformation gamma: RHom_S → Rg* RHom_T(Lg*(-),Lg*(-)). For all K,L, the inverse a-Hom transpose of gamma_(K,L) equals the bT-Hom transpose of t.inv_(RHom_S(K,L),K) followed by Lg* of the bS evaluation counit. No perfectness, quasi-coherence or base ring is required.

proof.text: Use exists_schemeHomTensorPullbackIso from GlobalHomAdjunctionIso to obtain t with its canonical predicate. This is the proved K-flat tensor-isomorphism construction of lem-pc-global-hom-adjunction, not the later global-Hom adjunction conclusion.

Define delta_(K,L) by transposing pulled-back evaluation along the fixed bT Hom equivalence after t.inv. Naturality of evaluation follows from three-variable naturality of the tensor-Hom equivalence: specialize once to internal Hom of the two-variable morphism, and once to identity in the first variable. To prove naturality of delta, uncurry by bT; naturality of t.inv and the evaluation equation identify both sides. Transpose delta by a to define gamma. The left and right naturality equations of a give naturality of gamma, and cancellation of the Hom equivalence gives the mate equation. Identify uncurrying of identity with the bS counit via homEquiv_symm_id. The private generic helper evaluationMate_exists proves the entire categorical calculation.
